# Epicentro Chile

> Epicentro Chile is Chile's leading news platform covering national politics, earthquakes, disasters, economics, and breaking news with live TV coverage.

The site provides comprehensive coverage of Chilean affairs including government policy under President Kast, regional incidents, and international news. It serves as a primary news source for Chilean citizens seeking updates on politics, natural disasters, crime, and cultural events.

## Key Topics

- Chile
- Kast government
- Carabineros
- Chilean politics
- National disasters
- Earthquake/seismic activity
- Puerto Varas
- Viña del Mar
- Crime incidents
- Public administration
- Political updates
- Police operations
- Weather alerts
- La Moneda
- Government policy

## National News & Politics

- [PAÍS - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/nacional): National news hub covering earthquakes, disasters, and major Chilean events
- [POLÍTICA - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/politica): Chilean politics coverage including Kast government and policy updates
- [Kast activa auditoría total al Estado: comité clave sesiona este viernes en La Moneda](https://www.epicentrochile.com/2026/03/19/kast-activa-auditoria-total-al-estado-comite-clave-sesiona-este-viernes-en-la-moneda): President Kast activates state audit; Strategic Audit Committee meets at La Moneda
- [Presidente Kast decreta tres días de Duelo Nacional por muerte de sargento Figueroa](https://www.epicentrochile.com/2026/03/20/presidente-kast-decreta-tres-dias-de-duelo-nacional-por-muerte-de-sargento-figueroa-atacar-a-un-carabinero-es-atacar-a-chile): President Kast declares national mourning for slain Carabinero Sargent Figueroa

- [Prisión preventiva para imputado por secuestro en Laguna Verde: Su hijo permanece prófugo](https://www.epicentrochile.com/2026/03/20/prision-preventiva-para-imputado-por-secuestro-en-laguna-verde-su-hijo-permanece-profugo): Preventive detention for Alfonso Vega in Laguna Verde kidnapping case; son at large

## Economy & Business

- [ECONOMÍA - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/economia): Chilean and international economic news, markets, and financial indicators

## Regional News & Cities

- [CIUDADES - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/ciudades): Local and regional news from Chilean cities including crime and incidents
- [Masivo corte de luz afecta a más de 7 mil clientes en Viña del Mar](https://www.epicentrochile.com/2026/03/20/masivo-corte-de-luz-afecta-a-mas-de-7-mil-clientes-en-vina-del-mar): Power outage affecting 7,000+ customers in Viña del Mar, Valparaíso region

## International & World News

- [MUNDO - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/mundo): International news coverage including Latin America and world events
- [Chuck Norris falleció a los 86 años - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/2026/03/20/chuck-norris-fallecio-a-los-86-anos-la-leyenda-de-las-artes-marciales-fallecio-en-hawai): Actor Chuck Norris dies at 86; martial arts legend and Walker Texas Ranger star

## Entertainment & Culture

- [CULTURA - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/panoramas): Culture and entertainment news including music, art, and celebrity coverage
- [ESPECTÁCULOS - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/espectaculos): Entertainment news with celebrity updates, music festivals, and awards
- [DEPORTES - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/deportes): Sports news covering football, Champions League, and Chilean leagues

## Optional & Additional Content

- [TENDENCIAS - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/tende): Trends section covering gaming, casinos, and entertainment industry
- [OPINIÓN - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/columnistas/opinion): Opinion columns on Chilean politics, environment, technology, and policy
- [Epicentro TV - Epicentro Chile](https://www.epicentrochile.com/tende/epitv): Epicentro TV channel with live coverage of politics, disasters, and news
